stories.headline: OpenAI rules out a 2026 IPO amid safety concerns
stories.summary: Sam Altman said OpenAI will not go public in 2026 and urged action on potentially catastrophic AI risks. He did not endorse a specific extinction-risk estimate; the company may be nearing an industry safety pact.

stories.headline: Anthropic CEO urges slower frontier-model progress
stories.summary: Dario Amodei called for slower capability gains, independent safety evaluators and coordination among AI companies and governments. He did not advocate stopping AI development, and implementation details remain unsettled.

stories.headline: Judge rules planned FEMA workforce cuts unlawful
stories.summary: A federal judge found that DHS violated post-Katrina law by directing FEMA to halve its workforce and blocking temporary-contract renewals. Remedies will be decided later; DHS and FEMA had not commented.

stories.headline: New Hormuz ship attack heightens supply concerns
stories.summary: UKMTO reported that a projectile struck a vessel in the Strait of Hormuz, causing a fire and crew evacuation. No group immediately claimed responsibility; the incident compounds disruption to regional oil routes.

stories.headline: Russian strike lands near Ukraine–Poland crossing
stories.summary: Officials said Russia struck a truck about half a mile from Poland, briefly closing a border crossing. Moscow said it targeted military-cargo infrastructure; the incident occurred close to NATO territory.
